reviews.decision: Root ADR 2448, §3 unlimited field inheritance / cached lineages
reviews.verdict: Reaffirm its no-depth-bound decision; qualify its treatment of non-inheritable convenience entries.
reviews.reason: EC3 §12.7.4.1 says only attributes designated inheritable in the relevant tables take parent values and prohibits a depth cap. ADR 2448 correctly establishes unbounded traversal for designated inheritable entries, but its own inventory calls RV/DS non-designated and yet reads them from any ancestor. That is separate from the valid owning-terminal-field-to-separate-widget lookup.

reviews.decision: Root ADR 1634 / 1635 rich-text subset and value-vs-rich-value selection
reviews.verdict: Reaffirm the bounded XFA rich-text subset and existing V/RV character-agreement rules; keep the DS ancestry question separate.
reviews.reason: The present evidence confirms markup/character controls and rich formatting, but does not justify expanding supported XFA. The candidate DS issue is where a style is sourced, not the CSS/XHTML subset or which value wins.

reviews.decision: Root ADR 1762 script field style writes
reviews.verdict: No contradiction found in the bounded scan; its direct field DA/Q edits are consistent with Table 228 inheritance and script-specific policy.
reviews.reason: The active issue is reading a noninheritable DS from a nonterminal ancestor. Script writes are field mutations and have their own current consumers; no evidence here supports recertifying the entire script property route.

Table 228's SHALLs addressed to the processor remain distinct from support for the full XFA 3.3 format. Existing code documents and implements a subset; this audit claims only the source-of-DS inheritance boundary.
